What we measured at Lara Hotel

Google Hotels listed Lara Hotel as a 3-star hotel. 2 of the 5 booking sites listed exactly the going rate. The highest, $150 on Booking.com and Bluepillow.in, was 138% above the lowest. None of the 5 sites named a room on its lowest listing. None of the 5 sites showed free cancellation on its lowest listing.

Questions about Lara Hotel prices

Which booking site listed the lowest price for Lara Hotel?

On September 30, 2026, for Nov 4 to Nov 6, Evendo was lowest of the 5 sites at $63 a night (listed price), 58% below the going rate of $150. Prices change daily, so for your dates another site may have the lowest price. Before you book: Is Evendo legit?

Was it cheaper to book Lara Hotel direct?

On September 30, 2026, for Nov 4 to Nov 6, the hotel's own site listed $76 a night (listed price). 2 of the 5 sites listed it for less; the lowest was $63 on Evendo, $13 under the hotel's own site. More on this: Booking.com vs booking direct.

How much did Lara Hotel prices differ between booking sites?

On September 30, 2026, for Nov 4 to Nov 6, the 5 sites we recorded ranged from $63 to $150 a night (listed price), $87 apart. The going rate was $150.
